bio.text: Jerry Starnes, a Republican, has represented Alabama House District 88 since November 9, 2022, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

He graduated from Prattville High School in 1986, earned a bachelor's degree in criminal justice from Troy University in 1991 and a master's degree in justice and public safety from Auburn University in 1996.
He served in the U.S. Army National Guard, reaching the rank of lieutenant colonel.

His career includes work as Autauga County probation and parole district manager with the Alabama Bureau of Pardons and Paroles, executive security officer of the Governor's Mansion, and correctional officer with the Alabama Department of Corrections.
